summary: Tested chunked upload feature for files > 20 MB. All backend endpoints (POST /api/upload/chunk, POST /api/upload/extract) work correctly. Frontend shows correct info text about chunked uploads. Admin login works. All 14 backend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/upload/chunk correctly accepts multipart/form-data with upload_id, filename, chunk_index, total_chunks, chunk file
POST /api/upload/chunk returns {status, chunk_index, received, total, complete} - complete=true when all chunks received
POST /api/upload/extract reassembles chunks and calls existing OCR pipeline
POST /api/upload/extract cleans up temp directory after extraction (verified by 404 on second call)
POST /api/extract-document-text (legacy) still works for small base64 files
pdfExtractor.js: chunkedUpload function exists with retry logic (exponential backoff)
DocumentUploader.jsx shows 'Les fichiers > 20 Mo sont uploades automatiquement en mode fractionne'
DossierExpressPage.jsx has onChunkProgress callback and chunk-progress display
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chunked upload feature fully tested.
